QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_59

question.text: Fund PQC Diversified has Rp=13.25%, σ=1.05%, β=1.01, Rf=5.60%. Sharpe ≈ ?

explanation.text: The Logic: (13.25-5.60)/1.05 = 7.65/1.05 ≈ 7.29. The Trap: 5.40 = Treynor Growth fund; 7.57 = Treynor Diversified; 10 is arbitrary. Cross-Exam Context: Example 12 of workbook. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For diversified funds, Sharpe and Treynor are close — a sanity check.
